summary.key_theme: 市場高度關注 Amazon 即將公布的財報，儘管分析師目標價看好且廣告業務成長潛力大，但 AI 資本支出壓力與監管調查帶來了不確定性。

bullish.title: Wall Street's Average Amazon Price Target Sits 34% Above the Stock -- 4 Days Before Its Earnings.
bullish.reason: 華爾街分析師平均目標價顯示該股仍有 34 % 的上漲空間，顯示市場對其長期基本面持高度信心。

bullish.title: 1 Reason to Buy Amazon Stock Before July 30 That Has Nothing to Do With AWS
bullish.reason: 強調 Amazon 的廣告業務具備強勁成長動能，為 AWS 之外的另一大獲利引擎，具備投資價值。

bullish.title: Ahead of Amazon Earnings, Here's What Barchart Data Says Comes Next for AMZN Stock
bullish.reason: 期權定價數據顯示市場預期 Amazon 在財報公布後股價將出現反彈。

bullish.title: Should You Buy Amazon Stock Before July 30?
bullish.reason: 分析認為該公司作為電商與雲端巨頭，仍是可靠的長期投資標的。

bullish.title: Is Now a Good Time to Buy Amazon Stock?
bullish.reason: 指出儘管股價接近歷史新高，但從估值角度看仍具備吸引力。

bullish.title: Top Four Magnificent 7 Stocks to Watch This Week: Apple, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon
bullish.reason: 將 Amazon 列為本週最受關注的科技巨頭之一，反映其在市場中的核心地位。

bullish.title: Amazon and Microsoft pivot cloud gaming strategies to target different players
bullish.reason: Amazon 將 Luna 整合至 Prime Video，顯示其在雲端遊戲領域的策略調整與生態系整合。

bullish.title: Amazon vs. Booking: Comparing Revenue Trends Between a Retail Giant and a Travel Titan
bullish.reason: 透過營收規模對比，凸顯 Amazon 作為零售巨頭的營收規模優勢。

bearish.title: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others
bearish.reason: 穆迪警告 AI 資本支出過高，迫使企業增加債務與股票發行，可能損害 Amazon 的信用評級與財務結構。

bearish.title: Amazon Stock Just Hit a Major Hurdle Ahead of Earnings
bearish.reason: 參議院的調查在財報前夕製造了不確定性，可能對股價造成短期壓力。

bearish.title: Warner Bros. lawsuit accuses Amazon of illegally poaching executives
bearish.reason: 華納兄弟提起的訴訟涉及非法挖角高管，可能引發關於勞動合約執行力的法律爭議。

bearish.title: Tesla, Intel, Google All Dropped After Earnings - Will Microsoft, Amazon, Meta Follow?
bearish.reason: 鑑於近期科技巨頭財報後股價普遍下跌，市場擔憂 Amazon 可能面臨類似的拋售壓力。

bearish.title: Amazon cracks down on use of AI images by sellers after New York law
bearish.reason: 因應紐約州法律，Amazon 需加強對 AI 生成內容的監管，增加了營運合規成本。

bearish.title: Walmart Is at $108. Here's Why Investors Should Take Pause.
bearish.reason: 指出 Walmart 近五年股價表現優於 Amazon，對投資人構成競爭壓力。

neutral.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Prices Dive On Iran Hopes; Apple Leads Earnings Wave, Fed Meeting Ahead
neutral.reason: 此類新聞彙整了宏觀經濟與多個科技巨頭的財報預期，Amazon 僅為其中之一，無特定個股利多或利空。

neutral.title: Dow Jones Futures Due, Iran News In focus; Apple Leads Earnings Wave, Fed Meeting Ahead
neutral.reason: 與上述新聞內容重複，主要關注宏觀環境與財報週，對 Amazon 個股影響中性。

neutral.title: What to Expect in Markets This Week: Amazon, Apple, Meta and Microsoft Earnings; Fed Interest Rate Decision
neutral.reason: 預告本週財報與聯準會利率決策，屬於市場例行性資訊。

neutral.title: Dow Jones Futures: U.S., Iran Halt Attacks After Market Sell Signal; Apple Earnings, Fed Meeting Ahead
neutral.reason: 宏觀市場動態報導，對 Amazon 股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Earnings Volatility Watch: 12 Stocks With Double-Digit Implied Moves This Week
neutral.reason: 僅指出財報週波動性，未對 Amazon 做出方向性預測。

neutral.title: Russia’s Amazon-style retail giant Wildberries is now in Ukraine’s crosshairs. Here's why
